from hep_lfx import HepComponent, payload, current_run, callback
from lfx.io import DataInput, Output
from lfx.schema import Data
import asyncio
class TestComponent(HepComponent):
 inputs=[DataInput(name="value",is_list=False,required=True)]
 outputs=[Output(name="result",method="build")]
 async def build(self)->Data:
  from hep_lfx import component
  value=self.value[0] if isinstance(self.value,list) else self.value
  return Data(data=await component("discover",payload(value),self._id))

from hep_lfx import HepComponent, payload, current_run, callback
from lfx.io import DataInput, Output
from lfx.schema import Data
import asyncio
class TestComponent(HepComponent):
 inputs=[DataInput(name="value",is_list=False,required=True)]
 outputs=[Output(name="stop",display_name="准备后停止？",method="route_stop",group_outputs=True),Output(name="create",display_name="准备后停止？",method="route_create",group_outputs=True),Output(name="preview",display_name="准备后停止？",method="route_preview",group_outputs=True)]
 async def route_stop(self)->Data:
  value=payload(self.value)
  selected='stop' if value['stop']=='prepare' else ('create' if value['stop']=='create-task' else 'preview')
  excluded=[name for name in ('stop', 'create', 'preview') if name!=selected]
  for name in excluded:self.stop(name)
  self.graph.exclude_branches_conditionally(self._id,excluded)
  return self.value
 async def route_create(self)->Data:
  value=payload(self.value)
  selected='stop' if value['stop']=='prepare' else ('create' if value['stop']=='create-task' else 'preview')
  excluded=[name for name in ('stop', 'create', 'preview') if name!=selected]
  for name in excluded:self.stop(name)
  self.graph.exclude_branches_conditionally(self._id,excluded)
  return self.value
 async def route_preview(self)->Data:
  value=payload(self.value)
  selected='stop' if value['stop']=='prepare' else ('create' if value['stop']=='create-task' else 'preview')
  excluded=[name for name in ('stop', 'create', 'preview') if name!=selected]
  for name in excluded:self.stop(name)
  self.graph.exclude_branches_conditionally(self._id,excluded)
  return self.value

from hep_lfx import HepComponent, payload, current_run, callback
from lfx.io import DataInput, Output
from lfx.schema import Data
import asyncio
class TestComponent(HepComponent):
 inputs=[DataInput(name="value",is_list=False,required=True)]
 outputs=[Output(name="go",display_name="请求执行且预览通过？",method="route_go",group_outputs=True),Output(name="stop",display_name="请求执行且预览通过？",method="route_stop",group_outputs=True)]
 async def route_go(self)->Data:
  value=payload(self.value)
  selected='go' if value.get('proceed') else 'stop'
  excluded=[name for name in ('go', 'stop') if name!=selected]
  for name in excluded:self.stop(name)
  self.graph.exclude_branches_conditionally(self._id,excluded)
  return self.value
 async def route_stop(self)->Data:
  value=payload(self.value)
  selected='go' if value.get('proceed') else 'stop'
  excluded=[name for name in ('go', 'stop') if name!=selected]
  for name in excluded:self.stop(name)
  self.graph.exclude_branches_conditionally(self._id,excluded)
  return self.value
